messages:
mira (PM): Need a compact rollout plan for model-v2 in EU focusing on safety and per-tenant opt-in. Constraints: p95 <= 420ms, 5xx < 0.7%, quality delta <= 0.5%. Can we make a tight preflight checklist?
liam (Eng): Suggest small-cohort approach: shadow 2h, 2% opt-in cohort (select customers), 10% broad canary, then 40% ramp. Each phase has automated regression checks.
anya (SRE): Rollback triggers: 5xx > 1% over 3m OR p95 > 700ms over 5m OR quality regression > 0.8%. We should also enforce a soft throttle per tenant during opt-in (max qps).
zara (CS): Two customers asked to join pilot but require opt-out ability and clear comms. I'll prepare an opt-in email and dashboard toggle. We need a test window date.
noah (Infra): For canary keep batch size small and disable aggressive KV prewarm. Reserve warm GPU pool (min 2 replicas) for EU region. Add a rate limiter that can be tightened live.
kevin (Security): For Dedicated/Private make sure KMS, audit logs, and telemetry PII filters are on by default. I'll sign off once checklist posted.
liam (Eng): Flag JSON we'll deploy to featureflag service:
```json
{"flag":"eu_model_v2_pilot","phases":[{"name":"shadow","pct":0,"dur":"2h"},{"name":"pilot","pct":2,"dur":"8h","per_tenant_opt_in":true},{"name":"canary","pct":10,"dur":"12h"},{"name":"ramp","pct":40,"dur":"48h"}],"kill_switch":true}
```
anya (SRE): Runbook items (short): 1) preflight smoke queries, 2) golden prompts quality check, 3) monitor p50/p95/p99 + errors + quality delta, 4) procedure to flip kill-switch and validate fallback within 15s.
mira (PM): Owners: liam=rollout lead, anya=SRE lead, zara=customer comms, kevin=security sign-off, noah=infra. Preflight at 11:00 UTC tomorrow.
zara (CS): I'll ask customers if Tue 09:00 UTC works for pilot start. Will post email draft here.
deploy-bot: schedule created: eu_model_v2_pilot @1767010100 phase=shadow
liam (Eng): I'll post the runbook link and the experiment IDs before we start. Please paste any extra test prompts you want in the thread.
anya (SRE): One more: add a dashboard card to show per-tenant rate limits during pilot. Helps detect noisy neighbors.
mira (PM): OK, small checklist in this thread before we hit shadow: runbook link, opt-in UI live, security checklist done, throttle caps set, and on-call notified. Reply when each is green.
